text:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — starting release: `serve-v2.3.0` rollout to prod in the 17:30 PT change window. We'll do a sentinel-run: 10% traffic, 15m hold, watch p95, error-rate, and key route latency. deploy-bot will post shifts.
Maria Gomez: ack. Can we pin the model-variant to q4-quant for this rollout? last time auto-quant caused perf variance.
Alex Chen: yes, pinning to `serve-v2.3.0+q4` in the config. Will include the note in release notes.
deploy-bot: [deploy] initiating rollout: serve-v2.3.0+q4 -> prod. stage=canary traffic=10% hold=15m. preflight checks: ok.
Jordan Patel: calling out routes to monitor: /generate, /chat/stream, /embeddings/bulk. Also watch KV cache hit-rate and prefix-cache eviction.
Samir K.: I'll own dashboards. I pushed a temporary panel in the deploy dashboard with per-route p95 and 5xx rate for those endpoints. Link: https://grafana.redwood/s/rollouts/serve-v2
Maria Gomez: added a small smoke test set to the eval-runner that hits chat/stream with typical prompts. If quality drops >5% for the smoke set, we auto-pause.
deploy-bot: [monitor] smoke-evals started (id: smoke-177888). expected duration ~2m.
sre-bot: ALERT: route `/chat/stream` increased 5xx rate from 0.08% -> 0.9% in the first 3 minutes. p95 latency +120ms. Severity: warning.
Alex Chen: saw that. Samir, can you check if it's a steady spike or single-region?
Samir K.: looking. It's concentrated in us-west-2 hosts on pool g12. KV cache miss rate up 4x there.
Jordan Patel: is there a correlating autoscaler event or recent instance churn in that pool?
Samir K.: no scaling events. kube node churn shows one node OOMKilled about 2m before. Could be warmup/eviction ripple.
Alex Chen: ok, let's pause the traffic shift. deploy-bot, pause and hold current traffic at 0% (no additional canary).
deploy-bot: [deploy] pausing rollout per request from Alex Chen. current traffic remains at 10% for existing canary.
Maria Gomez: good call. Also rolling back model-variant pin isn't necessary yet. We'll scope.
Jordan Patel: quick mitigation: increase prefix-cache TTL on affected pool and reboot the OOMKilled node via k8s control plane? Samir, do you want me to reboot or do you want to nurture the pool?
Samir K.: I'll drain and replace the problematic node, and bump prefix-cache TTL for the canary pods to 60s. Pushing manifests now.
Samir K.: (manifest snippet)
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
data:
  prefix_cache_ttl: "60"
```
Alex Chen: also toggle routing fallback to dedicated-small for failing requests? We can route errors to a lower-cost compatible variant to keep user-facing errors low.
Jordan Patel: add a temporary policy: if /chat/stream 5xx > 0.5% for 3 consecutive mins route 20% of traffic to `serve-v1-stable`. Can we do that as an immediate policy change?
Maria Gomez: I can flip the fallback rule in the routing console. Doing it now.
Maria Gomez: done — fallback rule active. deploy-bot, please report any traffic rebalancing.
deploy-bot: [routing] fallback rule applied: on /chat/stream 5xx>0.5% -> route 20% to serve-v1-stable.
sre-bot: NOTE: after fallback applied, observed 5xx on chat/stream drop to 0.22% within 90s. p95 back to +20ms.
Alex Chen: nice. Samir — when the node is replaced and cache warms, we can resume the rollout. Let's keep the hold for a full 15m window from now once stable.
Samir K.: node replaced and pods rescheduled. prefix-cache TTL applied. Monitoring heatmap now.
Samir K.: cache hit-rate recovering, now ~78% in us-west-2 (was 32%).
Jordan Patel: smoke-eval results? Maria?
Maria Gomez: smoke-eval completed: quality delta 0.6% down (within threshold). No regression flagged.
deploy-bot: [deploy] canary hold extended per manual pause. awaiting resume command from Alex Chen.
Alex Chen: OK. Resume when overall 5xx < 0.3% and p95 delta < 40ms for 10m. Anyone object?
Maria Gomez: no objections.
Jordan Patel: LGTM. I'll keep an eye on traces for tail latency outliers. :eyes:
Alex Chen: thanks all. I'll update the release notes with a short incident summary and the fallback policy we toggled. If anything changes ping #eng-oncall.
Samir K.: logging final snapshot to the deploy-run: `deploy/1778881234/snapshots/1`
deploy-bot: [deploy] thread closed by Alex Chen (manual hold). resume allowed by: Alex Chen, Maria Gomez, Jordan Patel.
Alex Chen: closing here — we'll re-open if we resume traffic. great coordination, everyone. :thumbsup:
